subject: [hw] DEC03 -> D01: facts for FACTS.md (VLD/AVC_VLD semantics, dead parseSliceHeaderHW, LAT unit, header oracle crop)
body:
For FACTS.md, with evidence; all [V] unless marked, all host-only (no phone):

1. `AVC_VLD reg n` (byte offset 4n from 0x16022000, n=1..32) shifts n bits and returns the NEXT 32-bit window; reg 0 peeks without advancing. Evidence: H264_HAL_ShiftGetBitStream @0xfd186 and H264_HAL_AVCVLDGetBitS @0xfd174 tail-call vdec_hal_read_avc_vld(hw,core,n); vdec_hal_h264_trailingbits @0x105244 returns read(8-pos). [V] shift, [V] returned window (the thunk returns it directly). Test: tests/hw/vdec/t_vendor.c calls both under the A32 interpreter with spec literals.
2. `AVC_VLD 0x8f = ue(v)`, `0x90 = se(v)`, `0x21 bits 16..21 = bit position`, `0xa3 = reset before the 0x2c/0x42 latch`. Evidence: vdec_hal_h264_uecodenum @0x1051d4, secodenum @0x10520c, vldshiftbits @0x105268, initbarrelshifter @0x104ec0. [V]
3. `VLD 0x2c = read pointer byte PA`, `0x2d/0x2e = vfifo start/end >>6`, `0x23 bit20 = fetch / bit23 = load barrel`, `0x42 bit8 = latch`, `0x3a bit0 = fetch ready`, `0x3b [7:0]/[15:8]/[25:24]`, `0x34 [23:16]`, `0x3f` DRAM pointer. Evidence: vdec_hal_set_vld_vfifo @0x28bf4, vdec_hal_vld_init_barrel_shift @0x29460, vdec_hal_init_fetch_done @0x29388, vdec_hal_read_vld_rptr @0x2a7a8. [V] use/formula, [I] exact hardware units for 0x3b/0x34/0x3f/0x2c.
4. `The live slice header is software; parseSliceHeaderHW @0x110eb8 and the h264_comhal_* table @0x163b68 have no caller or relocation in this build.` The VLD is used per slice by handleSLICENALU: barrel-shifter init, H264_HAL_GetStartCode_8530 @0xfd5fc, one ue (first_mb_in_slice), H264_HAL_Read_VldRPtr @0x108aa4. Header-only START touches zero VDEC registers. Evidence: facts/VDEC_REGISTERS.md §0 (opus-dec2), dec1/vdec_ref.c trace, our t_vendor differential. [V]
5. `LAT core = vendor core index 3, with LAT_VLD 0x16011000 and LAT_AVC_VLD 0x16012000` (vdec_drv_init_hw_info @0x1e1b8 slot table; opus-dec2 §1). Which context handleSLICENALU uses is [I]; model both. [V] block addresses, [I] selection.
6. `HEVC_VLD is at 0x16028000` (vdec_drv_init_hw_info writes 0x28000 to hw+0x160; vdec_hal_read_hevc_vld @0x2c7dc); ue/se at 0x26/0x27, trailing position 0x21 bits 8..10. H265_parseSliceHeader @0xccfe0 is the consumer; H265_parseSPS/PPS are software. [V]
7. `Header-only START reports coded dimensions`: vsi.pic.pic_w/pic_h and buf_w/buf_h are coded (1920x1088 for a 1920x1080 stream); vsi.crop = {left,top,width,height} is the display rectangle; changed=0x23. Measured with dec1/vdec_ref.c on T02 fake: 320x240 pic=320x240 buf=320x256 crop=0,0,320,240 dpb=7; 1920x1080 pic=1920x1088 crop=0,0,1920,1080; 1920x808 pic=1920x816 crop=0,0,1920,808. ffprobe equals crop[2..3], not pic_h. [V]
8. `No phone, no publish`; the model is host-only, T02 hook proposed but not landed.

Full detail and the register tables: gpu/hwcodec/tests/hw/vdec/REGISTERS.md; test line `N2TEST DEC03 PASS 2781/2781` from `bash gpu/hwcodec/tests/hw/vdec/run_tests.sh`.
